tlg_checks.needle: αὐτοδέσποτός ἐστιν τῶν παθῶν ὁ εὐσεβὴς λογισμός

tlg_checks.note: exact Swete phrase 'ἐπαροιμίαζεν ἡμῖν τὸν λέγοντα' misses because TLG E follows Rahlfs (ὑμῖν, om. τόν); shorter distinctive substrings from same verse hit

edition_statement: Henry Barclay Swete, The Old Testament in Greek, vol. 3, Cambridge University Press, 1905 (First1KGreek tlg0527.tlg026.1st1K-grc1, digitized via The Internet Archive, CC BY-SA 4.0)
issues: Upstream OCR corruption in the First1KGreek source file, kept byte-verbatim per zero-fabrication policy: 4 Macc. 1.1 reads 'ΦIΔΟΣOΦΩΤΑΤΟΝ' (Latin I/O + Δ-for-Λ OCR error for ΦΙΛΟΣΟΦΩΤΑΤΟΝ); ~19 tokens across the work contain Latin-letter OCR substitutions (e.g. 'Bλλʼ' 12.11, 'εὐσεβείmς' 1.24, 'καρτερίn' 2.x, 'aόνον' 9.x).

Passage '4 Macc. 17.7-14' contains literal 'U+03F2' escape strings in place of lunate sigma plus heavy OCR garbling in vv. 17.9-10 ('φυνὴ φεραιά', 'Ἐβρδίων πολιτίαν') — present verbatim in the upstream XML; flag for manual repair against Swete vol. 3 before corpus promotion.
Greek-letter ratio < 0.97 in exactly 1 of 71 passages (17.7-14, ratio 0.964) — same OCR cause.
Editorial apparatus and marginal sigla are encoded as <note> elements in the TEI and were excluded; no TEI tag or note text leaked into text_content (verified by regex gate).
